cites.quote: The patient list already shows each patient's next appointment (HMS-1).
Hospital time zone Asia/Kolkata, currency INR.
Medical history appears only on the patient's own page, never in lists, the dashboard or logs.
A past appointment the patient attended, closed by staff once its start time has passed.
Completed, Cancelled and No-show appointments never change.
in the MVP every user acts as `staff`.
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.
The most recent Completed appointment and its displayed date are determined by the appointment `start time`.

findings.suggested_fix: Split it into two REQs: one says start time ranks 'most recent', the other says the displayed date is that appointment's start date in Asia/Kolkata.
findings.text: REQ-13 is a compound requirement. It sets both the ranking rule for 'most recent' and the source of the displayed date in one statement.

cites.quote: The patient list already shows each patient's next appointment (HMS-1).
The Last visit date uses the same date format as the existing `next appointment` column.

findings.suggested_fix: Cite the HMS-1 artifact or the code that defines the Next appointment format, or rely on Q-02 alone.
findings.text: REQ-14's basis cites ticket L14. That line only says the next appointment is shown and gives no format, so the cite does not prove there is an existing format to match.

cites.quote: Sorting or filtering by Last visit: not asked for.
options: [display only, sortable, sortable and filterable]

findings.suggested_fix: State that Out of scope holds unless Q-03 is answered otherwise, or drop the sortable options because the ticket keeps the current sort order.
findings.text: Sorting and filtering by Last visit is declared out of scope, but Q-03/U-4 leave the same question open with 'sortable' as an option.

rubric_items.reason: Every acceptance criterion (L16-L22) maps to a requirement: REQ-1 to REQ-12. The criteria are split correctly, for example L18 into REQ-4/5/6 and L20-21 into REQ-8/9/10/11. Sorting by Last visit is out of scope, with a reason.
Nearly all REQs are atomic and checkable. REQ-13 combines two decisions in one statement: how 'most recent' is ranked and which date is displayed.

Known items are cited to the ticket or baseline, and the Asia/Kolkata value comes from the baseline constraints. REQ-13 has a real glossary basis. REQ-14's cite (L14) shows only that the column exists, not what date format it uses.
No clash between the ticket and the baseline: the medical history rule and the time zone agree with data-protection and constraints. Nothing was resolved silently.
Four non-blocking questions, each with real options and defaults. Product decisions go to the product owner and the glossary question goes to the tech lead.
Plain and readable, and glossary status terms are used consistently. Sorting is both listed as Out of scope and kept open as Q-03, which is a small inconsistency.
